tagline: Modernizing data infrastructure for the AI era
hero_kpi_rationale: The HPC/Cloud segment is the primary growth driver for PSTG, directly capturing demand from AI adoption and data-intensive workloads, particularly through hyperscalers and cloud-native applications.

kpis.name: HPC / Cloud / AI Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to storage solutions for artificial intelligence and cloud environments
kpis.description: This revenue includes sales to hyperscalers and FlashBlade solutions used for AI model training. A major initial delivery with a hyperscaler was completed in 2026.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to software integration and optimized manufacturing costs through external partners.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves with the ramp-up of recurring revenues and better expense discipline.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: R&D investments remain high to accelerate innovation in flash modules and software automation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Investments focus on cloud infrastructure and internal software, not semiconductor fabrication plants.

kpis.name: Service / Subscription / ARR Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from subscriptions and cloud services
kpis.description: Driven by Evergreen, Portworx, and cloud offerings, this revenue is becoming an increasing portion of the total. Corresponds to subscription services revenue of $1.691B in FY2026.
kpis.signal: Recurring base growing, revenue visibility rising

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: Headcount is increasing to support sales, marketing, and product development.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K)

stories_kpis.name: AI-related Cloud Deals Mix
stories_kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud deals that include AI capabilities.
stories_kpis.description: An increasing number of customers are integrating AI workloads into their data center modernization projects.

stories_kpis.name: Net Bookings
stories_kpis.explanation: Value of new orders signed during the year.
stories_kpis.description: Orders show strong momentum, driven by large enterprises and hyperscalers.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSTG does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.

risks.title: Compromise of cybersecurity systems
risks.summary: If Everpure's (PSTG) IT systems are hacked or compromised, the company could suffer customer losses, significant fines, and severe reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the report (Item 1A), with very strong language ('material adverse impact', 'material interruption', 'significant fines, penalties and liabilities'). Stable trend with enhanced governance framework (ESC, GISO, CISO). Maximum-weight cybersecurity category.

risks.title: Procédures judiciaires pouvant affecter les résultats
risks.summary: Everpure may be involved in litigation related to its ordinary course of business, and an adverse decision could negatively impact its financial results or cash flow.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the middle of the report (Item 3), with moderate language ('could materially affect our future results of operations, cash flows or financial position'). Stable trend, recurring risk related to normal course of business. Medium-weight litigation category.

risks.title: Dependence on a single large hyperscaler customer
risks.summary: An increasing portion of Everpure's revenue depends on a single large hyperscaler customer. If this customer reduces orders or switches suppliers, revenues could drop sharply.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the MD&A section (mid-report) using neutral language but indicative of high concentration ('hyperscaler customer' in singular, 'large production deployments'). Trending upward given the strategic emphasis placed on this customer. Competition category with high weighting in case of losing this partner.

risks.title: Revenue volatility of products according to order cycles
risks.summary: Everpure hardware product sales can fluctuate significantly from quarter to quarter depending on the size and timing of orders, making results difficult to predict.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the MD&A section (middle of report) with moderate language ('may vary from period to period'). Stable trend, inherent to the equipment sales business model. Medium-weight capital category as it affects cash flow predictability.

risks.title: Rising operating costs weighing on profitability
risks.summary: Everpure expects an increase in all its expense categories (manufacturing, sales, R&D, administration) in absolute terms, which could compress margins if revenue growth does not keep pace.
risks.score_rationale: Risk present throughout the MD&A section (middle of report), with repeated and systematic language ('expect...to increase in absolute dollars') for each cost item. Upward trend acknowledged by management. Moderately-weighted industrial category, but structural risk on margins.

risks.title: Risques liés aux résultats futurs incertains (forward-looking)
risks.summary: Everpure's published forecasts may not materialize due to numerous uncertain factors, potentially disappointing investors and causing the stock price to decline.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned at the beginning of the MD&A section (middle of report) with strong language ('may differ materially from those anticipated'). Stable trend, standard but significant warning for investors. Capital category as it directly affects valuation and market expectations.

risks.title: Absence of dividends and a retained earnings policy.
risks.summary: Everpure does not pay dividends and does not intend to do so, meaning shareholders can only rely on stock price appreciation for investment returns.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the stock market section (middle of report) with neutral language ('do not anticipate paying any dividends in the foreseeable future'). Stable trend, consistent policy. Low capital weighting but relevant for income-seeking investors.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
